Where is the OBD-II port?

Under the lower driver-side dashboard trim, to the left of the steering column just above the bonnet release lever.

Mileage & VIN check on this generation

On the C6 (4F) TP 2.0 platform, the instrument cluster, EDC16/EDC17 diesel ECUs and fault-code freeze frames often record mileage, while some petrol ECUs expose fewer dedicated distance channels. Always weigh OBD readings alongside service history and MOT/inspection records. Read the mileage check guide · VIN check guide

What to check before buying or maintaining

  • Scan 34 Level Control on air-suspension models for compressor overheat warnings, valve-block leaks or ride-height sensor errors.
  • On 5.0 TFSI V10 (RS6) and FSI/TFSI petrol engines, use the bundled low-pressure fuel pump (LPFP) guided procedure or live measuring blocks to verify fuel supply under load.
  • On 2.7 TDI and 3.0 TDI V6 engines, check injector correction values, intake-manifold swirl-flap faults (P2015 family) and DPF ash load.
  • Check 61 Battery Regulation and 07/5F MMI modules for quiescent current or MOST fibre-optic ring breaks (amplifier/tuner water ingress in the boot).

What VAG Scope supports on this chassis

Tested extensively on a real 2010 Audi RS6 C6 (vLinker MC+ over BLE), including Android Auto dashboards, LPFP procedure, mileage check, coding and Performance Hub.

  • Pre-purchase health check: fault codes, cross-module mileage comparison and VIN check in one signed PDF report.
  • Full control-unit scan, advanced identification and fault clearing with automatic backup and confirmation.
  • Searchable live data (measuring blocks / UDS DIDs), 60-second charts, CSV logging and Android Auto dashboards.
  • Performance Hub: 0-500 km/h timing (100 Hz OBD + phone IMU fusion), virtual dyno and signed PNG/PDF proof cards without GPS permission.
  • Coding, long coding, gateway installation list, adaptations, basic settings, output tests and service reset with automatic backup and read-back.

Frequently asked questions

Has VAG Scope actually been tested on a real Audi A6 / RS6 C6?

Yes. A 2010 Audi RS6 C6 is the primary real-car TP 2.0 test vehicle for VAG Scope, including Android Auto live gauges, coding, adaptations and Performance Hub pulls.

Can I preview the RS6 C6 in the app before buying an adapter?

Yes. An Audi RS6 C6 demo car is built into the home screen with realistic TP 2.0 measuring blocks, fault codes and virtual dyno behaviour.

Why does my A6 C6 fail to connect with a cheap blue ELM327?

C6 modules use TP 2.0 with strict channel keep-alives (every 0.6 s). Cheap clones drop frames and time out; a vLinker MC+ over BLE or Classic handles it reliably.

Can I code battery replacement or service resets on an A6 C6?

Yes. Service interval resets, battery coding in module 61, adaptations and long coding run offline after confirmation and backup.
